pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_executions/components/list/ExecutionValueBadges.tsx:18 The list, comparison, rerun and trace-bar surfaces neither run nor display a model-judge verdict: the list's 'verdict' column (useExecutionColumns.tsx:115-120) renders only the agent's self-reported business_outcome, and the Director star rating was removed on 2026-10-19 (ExecutionValueBadges.tsx:11-15). A case-insensitive search of src/features/agents/sub_executions for judge, rescor, unscored and sample_rate returned zero hits, so no scoring loop exists here to sample, settle or dedupe.

techniques.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_executions/components/list/useExecutionColumns.tsx:120 The verdict column shows business_outcome, not a sampled judge score. Nothing here chooses which traces get judged.
